implementation_contract.owner_container: read-only Linux non-root container containing only frozen CartPoleWind source text, owned source-only mock server, and private synthetic canary; no original source Python import
implementation_contract.learner_container: separately built read-only Linux non-root client image containing ONLY client protocol code; original source, private marker, repository and Docker socket not mounted
implementation_contract.network: fresh Docker internal bridge scoped to two containers with only one protocol port, no published host port
implementation_contract.host_capabilities: GitHub-hosted ubuntu Docker only; no privileged mode; --cap-drop ALL; --security-opt no-new-privileges; --read-only; --pids-limit, --memory and --cpus
implementation_contract.source_worker_protocol: bounded newline-delimited JSON, strict message count/size, allow health/probe/quit only, reject direct introspection, see, ctf_do, env, path, private wind, raw info and episode actions
implementation_contract.synthetic_public_response: four finite state values, one finite reward, terminal/truncation; never source wind, original info or source references
implementation_contract.source_private_canary: private wind marker and actual original source file exist only in source-owner image; client explicitly verifies absence
implementation_contract.forbidden_fallback: if Docker unavailable, container isolation, network, file separation, or tests fail then FAIL CLOSED, no local same-process simulator acceptance
